svg.title: Transformer — faithful editable reconstruction of Figure 1
svg.desc: Reconstructed from Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al., 2017), Figure 1, PDF page 3. Original architecture, label order, residual paths, pastel colors and layout retained. Native editable SVG geometry and text; no embedded bitmap. Roboto Light is used to approximate the original typography. Reconstruction is not pixel-identical to the original.
